title: SEL-351 Distribution Feeder Overcurrent Protection
description: SEL-351 feeder protection relay settings configuring phase and ground instantaneous (50P/50G) and inverse-time (51P/51G) overcurrent elements with SELogic trip and breaker close equations.
code:

RELAY="SEL-351"
RID="SUB_OAK_FDR12"
TID="SEL-351 FEEDER 12 MAIN"
ACTIVE_GROUP=1
NFREQ=60.0
PHROT=ABC
CTRH=120
CTRL=120
PTR=120
PTRN=120

GROUP 1
50P1P=12.00
50P2P=24.00
51P1P=4.00
51P1C=U3
51P1TD=2.00
50G1P=3.00
51G1P=1.20
51G1C=U3
51G1TD=1.50
TRIP=50P1P OR 51P1T OR 50G1P OR 51G1T
CLOSE=!TRIP AND IN101
OUT101=TRIP
OUT102=CLOSE
